title: And yes there is a “Shrek is Love, Shrek is Life” sequence #Shrek #Bu...
transcript: Are you a fan of Shrek or burlesque? Then boy do I have a show for you! it's called Swamplesque and it is currently playing at the Edinburgh Fringe for the second year in a row and it is a wild campy time it essentially retells the story of Shrek but with a series of burlesque numbers and these can be anything from drag performances to live singing to strip teases to contortionists The Magic Mirror even does a disco ball aerial act at one point maybe my favorite act was the Gingerbread Man doing a strip tease to buttons I honestly don't even wanna tell you anymore just in case you're able to see it because so much of the fun came from the surprise of what the next number was gonna be but it really is the most fun night you can have out at fringe it's kind of brilliant just how well they're able to blend the world of burlesque with the story of Shrek and how much sense it all makes because at its core the story of Shrek is about embracing the things that make us special the things that make us different and burlesque being born of the queer community is very much doing the same thing and so while yes Swamplesque is incredibly silly there is actually a deeper message to it that I think is really profound
